name: Colossus
notes: Piotr Rasputin was born on a farming collective in the former USSR. He left his homeland to join the X-Men. He is soft spoken and mild-mannered, with an artist's temperament. He is slow to anger, but woe to everyone around when he does.

kit.name: Man of Steel
always: When you roll a Twist on a test of physical athleticism you may become Winded in order to re-roll the Skill check.

powers.name: Brush it Off
powers.text: You may spend an Action Point to ignore one Condition for the duration of a conflict.

powers.name: Stoic
powers.text: When you put yourself in harm's way and gain a Condition as a result, you earn one Action Point.

attack_table_rider: Regain 1 HP on any roll of 3+

powers.name: Unstoppable
powers.effect: Shift 2 squares before or after this attack.

powers.name: Hurled Object
powers.effect: Slide the target 2 squares after the attack.

powers.name: Hammer Blow
powers.effect: Throws the target 2 squares. If an obstacle cuts this short, they fall Prone.

powers.name: Earth-shaking Stomp
powers.effect: +2 damage if the target is Prone.

powers.name: Fastball Special <R>
powers.effect: Throw an ally within reach up to R6. Target takes ✸2 and falls Prone.

powers.name: Mark Target
powers.effect: Target becomes Marked. You may have up to two Marked targets at once. Marked targets grant Opportunity when they attack someone else or move away.

powers.name: Living Steel Transformation
powers.effect: You transform to Living Steel form. For the rest of the encounter you may use a Move Action to switch back and forth between this form and human form. When you switch, push all adjacent units 1 square. You now occupy a 2x2 space on the grid. Make this attack against one target; as well as damage, that target is knocked Prone.

powers.name: Toughness + Resilient + Fortitude
powers.effect: Triggers: when you roll 3+ on an attack, regain 1 HP; when you take non-attack damage, Resist +1. Passives (already included elsewhere): Resist 1 to all damage; your Saving Throws succeed on 3+; your HP have been increased by 3; you may Rally twice per encounter; regain +1 HP whenever you Rally or are Healed.

powers.name: Skin of Steel
powers.effect: Trigger: When an enemy hits you with an attack, spend one Action Point to ignore it.

powers.name: Skin of Steel (Prone Watch)
powers.effect: Trigger: If a Prone enemy within reach attempts to stand, they grant you an Opportunity.

role_actions.name: Defender
role_actions.effect: Trigger: An enemy grants you Opportunity — spend one Action Point to cancel their action.

role_actions.name: Get Behind Me! <R>
role_actions.effect: One adjacent ally gains cover until they end their turn not adjacent to you.

role_actions.name: Rally
role_actions.effect: Spend 1 Action Point: Heal 5 HP. Regain one Encounter power. Choose one boost: +1 reach | +4 speed | all HTH attacks become "HTH or R5".
